svg.aria-label: A puppet theatre drawn in terminal characters. A giant, still figure leans over the stage and sends threads to four marionettes, who jerk upright and take tasks from a pile. The reviewer fails one task and then passes it, and the lead merges the work one piece at a time.

g.text: $ the lead stays still. every teammate is on a string.
$ each one takes the next free task from the pile.
$ whoever wrote it does not review it.
$ the lead checks, and merges one at a time.
$ when the work is done, the strings come off.
